# billy

> billy is a web-based invoice editor for freelancers and small businesses, currently on a waitlist. You click any field on the invoice and type, then export a print-ready PDF.

## Status
- Not yet launched. Early access is by waitlist at https://trybilly.tech.
- Contact: hello@trybilly.tech
